easyPrerequisites: Have a Bite must have valid targets.
description:
Cast Have a Bite using the convoke ability from Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Adventurous Eater.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Adventurous Eater, which enters prepared.
Resolve Have a Bite.
Repeat.
